observation.happening: A dark floating pill toolbar overlaid during a Google Meet call, actively recording (red dot) at 5:12 elapsed.
observation.most_important: Recording is live; primary destructive action (red square stop button) sits at the far right, separated from the neutral toggles.
observation.next_action: Toggle メモ (notes), 字幕 (captions), Ask Astra, hide (eye), pause, or stop the recording.
anomalies: Dotted animated segment next to the title has no visible label, so its purpose is unclear from a still frame
Three of six controls (eye/pause/stop) are icon-only with no text, relying entirely on icon convention

ai_look: Sparkle icon on "Ask Astra" is a fairly stock AI-feature affordance
E3ED.why: Clean, compact, well-aligned pill toolbar with clear primary/secondary separation, but it's a familiar meeting-overlay pattern (icon row + red stop button) seen across many similar apps, not a standout.

observation.happening: A minimal dark strip showing a loading/preparation state before some action begins.
observation.most_important: The text "準備中..." (preparing) is the only status signal.
observation.next_action: Press Esc (shown as a hint pill) to cancel.
anomalies: No spinner, progress bar, or pulsing element accompanies "preparing" — in a static image the blue dot reads as inert, indistinguishable from a stalled/frozen state
Large empty gap between the status text and the esc hint with no content filling it

ai_look: Bare loading state with no motion/progress cue reads as an unfinished placeholder
EC41.why: A loading state that provides no visible progress affordance is a concrete state-clarity defect — the user has no way to tell if it's actively working or stuck.

visible_text: 決まったこと・まだありません
やること・まだありません

observation.happening: A live meeting recording/transcription screen: left pane shows meeting notes with empty decision/todo sections, right pane shows the raw timestamped transcript with color-coded speakers.
observation.most_important: Two transcript lines are flagged with a blue dot (an OAuth scope comment and "承知しました。稟議を通します。" — a clear approval/decision), suggesting they were marked important.
observation.next_action: Type a question in the bottom input, or tap 要約/決まったこと/やること quick-action chips.
anomalies: The flagged line "承知しました。稟議を通します。" reads as an explicit decision, yet the left panel's 決まったこと (decisions) section still says まだありません (none yet) — a visible contradiction between the flagged transcript content and the summary state

ai_look: "AIが見ている資料" footer phrasing is a common AI-transparency pattern, used here without overuse
F022.why: A flagged transcript line that clearly reads as a decision is not reflected in the decisions summary section, a state inconsistency visible directly in the screenshot.

observation.happening: The dark meeting toolbar expanded downward into a transcript panel, with the 字幕 (captions) tab active, showing a running dialogue with timestamps.
observation.most_important: The most recent line is an unanswered question, "誰が対応しますか?" (who will handle this), left dangling at the bottom of the visible transcript.
observation.next_action: Click "会議の横に開く" to pop the panel out beside the call, or switch to 翻訳/ライブ tabs.
anomalies: Panel's top corners are square (fused to the toolbar above) while bottom corners are rounded — an intentional attached-surface treatment rather than a flaw

F390.why: Well-executed and internally consistent, but it is essentially a standard speaker-labeled transcript list — the same pattern used by many competing meeting-assistant tools, so it doesn't clear the bar for top-tier distinctiveness.

observation.happening: The same style of meeting screen as F022, but now later in the call: the transcript has been successfully categorized into 決まったこと (decisions), やること (todos), 質問 (questions), and 懸念 (concerns), each traceable to its source line.
observation.most_important: Each categorized card matches its corresponding transcript line exactly (e.g. 鈴木's "誰が対応しますか?" appears under 質問), showing the extraction working correctly this time.
observation.next_action: Expand a card's chevron for detail, or use 出所/直す to trace the source or edit the item.
anomalies: None significant — categorization is internally consistent with the transcript, unlike the earlier-stage screen (F022) where a flagged decision wasn't reflected in the summary

ai_look: Categorization taxonomy (決まったこと/やること/質問/懸念) is specific rather than generic AI buzzwording — a positive
F764.why: Solid, internally consistent execution of a two-pane transcript+summary layout with correct categorization, but the underlying pattern is common to several meeting-assistant products and doesn't distinguish itself further.

observation.happening: A macOS-style app showing a Library entry for a short recorded meeting, with an extracted decision, memos, and a raw transcript with two speakers.
observation.most_important: The single extracted decision: "macOS を先に出すことに決めました。" (decided to ship macOS first).
observation.next_action: Switch to 録音/関連ファイル/出所 tabs, or click a [1][2][3] citation to jump to its transcript line.
anomalies: The title "21:40 の会議" is rendered twice in a row — once as a small breadcrumb bar, once as a large heading directly beneath it with a back chevron — a redundant duplicate title
The memo and transcript both contain "Windowsは次の周で追います" — 周 (lap/circumference) appears to be a kanji-conversion typo for 週 (week), undermining trust in transcription accuracy
A large blank area occupies roughly the lower half of the canvas with no content, footer, or affordance explaining it

ai_look: Numbered footnote-style [1][2][3] citations linking prose back to transcript lines feels like a generic AI-report convention
Large unexplained empty canvas below sparse content reads as an unfinished/placeholder layout
F7F2.why: Concrete visible defects: a duplicated title/heading wasting vertical space, a kanji typo (周/週) in transcribed text that undercuts trust in the core transcription feature, and a large dead empty area beneath the content.
